mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES stays near its current depressed level while TRANSIT remains far below baseline, commuter-linked discretionary shopping stays weak and RETAIL_REC remains lower over the next four weeks than over the prior four weeks.

fact:TRANSIT stayed between -38.1 and -28.4 over the four observed weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC averages higher over the next 28 days than over the last 28 days despite WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remaining below baseline.

evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose to 39.7 at t-1w after being -0.7 at t-2w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall relative to the prior four-week mean within 14 days after PARKS crosses above 30 points.

fact:TRANSIT stayed at least -28.4 in all four weeks
